name: Unionville / Centennial College / University of Toronto Scarborough
description: A documented school-period GO route, distinct from its surrounding Table 52 corridor. The original explicitly prints route number 50, with three morning southbound and three afternoon northbound trips.

timeline.event: The original combined timetable identifies route 50 between Unionville GO, Centennial College Progress Court and UTSC; trips are excluded during the listed December 2008–January 2009 school holiday.
Route 50 is absent from the later combined Highway 407 East timetable; this establishes an archive boundary, not an exact withdrawal date.

sources.title: GO Highway 407 East timetable, internally dated November 1, 2008 (archived February 19, 2009)
GO routes 51, 52 and 54 timetable, effective December 31, 2011 (archived August 23, 2012)

gaps: The route’s exact introduction and final operating dates have not been established.
No full all-stop GTFS or original geographic route map has yet been recovered for 50; the pattern records its three published timing points.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
